title: Place the units
prompt: units maps a unit name to how many to place. Print the name once per unit, so {"knight": 2} prints knight twice.
hints: A loop inside the loop: the inner one repeats by the amount.

docs.name: for key in data:
docs.what: Runs once per key; data[key] gives its value.

docs.name: data[key]
docs.what: The value stored under key. Assigning to it changes or adds the entry.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

docs.name: range(n)
docs.what: The numbers 0 up to n - 1, for a for loop to count through.
